page.notes: Doubtful readings: "pissimo"/"pissimam"/"pissimi" (long s and i/j spelling as printed); "prabeo" kept as printed; "Irenen." and "Baronium" are uncertain; the Hadrian date "Ioccxxci" is hard to read and is marked [?]; the note on Agatho's letter, "epistolam", is uncertain. The text marks {f} and the note letter f are read from a superscript that could also be a long s; they are kept as printed and should be checked. The Hadrian note "pag.257" may read differently. Printed page number 212 and running head "De Authoritate, & Dignitate" with "Cap.5." in the head; the chapter number is not part of the running head.
